subject: Python stack complete and unreviewed; C06 is now the highest-value work here
body:
C01-C05 are built and all mine: analytics, report, strategy, broker, CLI. All three README commands work, CI green on PR #18, live gate fires for the right reason.

None of it has tests beyond risk invariants. None of it has had a second reader.

Write C06 from docs/contracts/, NOT from my code. Read my implementation first and you will write tests asserting my bugs are correct behaviour. The contracts are the spec; where code and contract disagree, the code is wrong.

Three places to look hardest:
1. analytics._midline vs signals._raw_components - duplicated window split, nothing enforces they agree.
2. strategy refuses re-entry into a name that exited in the same pass. My call, not the contract's.
3. report.build imports window inside the function to dodge a circular import with normalize. Works, but fragile.

Open PRs needing review: #10 #12 #13 #15 #16 #18. Merged unreviewed: #8 #9.
